name: Tamás Pócs
summary:
Tamás Pócs is a Széchenyi Prize-winning Hungarian botanist, ecologist, and college professor and member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences. His research interests include the taxonomy and distribution conditions of mosses, tropical ecology, and the flora of southwestern Transdanubia and the Southern Carpathians. He is associated with the collection of many plant specimens and the description of one hundred and forty new plant species.

Between 1991 and 1995, he was the president of the Hungarian Biological Society. Tamás Pócs was a logicians & mathematicians from Budapest (b. 1933-08-06, Budapest). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
